overal.goal: Always show a chat box at the bottom of every page, like a terminal in boof. Users can communicate with the page through that input: ask questions, give commands (create a task, queue, stop, open a screen) and get answers in context of the page they are on. A new project always opens with this input asking the user to define and explain the project.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI (shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4), vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-ui-redesign-design.md before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npx vitest run && npm run build:server` before finishing.
Every command the chat box can run is reachable through REST, MCP and the CLI as well as the web UI and the desktop app.
Decide in a design document what answers the chat (which model or harness, see owlish-accounts) and how it maps text to boof operations.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.
Do not let the chat run destructive operations (delete, stop) without the same confirmation the UI asks for.

versions.version: Requested by the owner on 2026-10-29; not started.

tests.strategy: Unit tests for command parsing and routing; UI checks on each screen at desktop and 420 px.
